name: shumap
description: Campus map data helpers for SHUMap

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=400623ade20e6d96cb546c98bcf3e33f npx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.migrations:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=400623ade20e6d96cb546c98bcf3e33f npx wrangler d1 migrations apply shumap-v2-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply shumap-v2 --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply shumap-v2 --local
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:schema && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:split && npm run test:guide-icons
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
